data_scope: league decision support; external trade values are separate from WFC canon
consensus_method: For each provider, convert its rank/value order to a 0–100 within-provider percentile. Average only those normalized values. Provider raw values are displayed but never averaged.
wfc_adjustments: QB scarcity: +12 for ranks 1–12, +8 for ranks 13–24, +3 otherwise. Package values are limited by the receiving team’s 3-QB cap.

providers.name: WFC manual value board
providers.scoring_format: WFC · full PPR · 1 QB + 1 Superflex · 4 pt pass TD
providers.access: Commissioner-maintained manual board; seed records transcribed from the user-supplied reference image.
providers.normalization: Displayed as entered; included in consensus only as a within-board percentile
providers.notes: The first-class board. Edit the reviewed local snapshot to set values, tiers, market values, and historical points.

providers.name: WFC internal rankings
providers.scoring_format: WFC · full PPR · 1 QB + 1 Superflex · 4 pt pass TD
providers.normalization: Rank → percentile within the provider pool
providers.notes: Derived from WFC roster context, permitted private forward signals where available, approved legacy rank inputs, and rostered-player results. Not a public-source value chart.

providers.name: WFC daily market model
providers.scoring_format: WFC · full PPR · 1 QB + 1 Superflex · 4 pt pass TD
providers.normalization: Rank/value → percentile within the WFC model pool
providers.notes: Private ESPN UDK preseason anchors are blended with WFC v2 rest-of-season value-over-replacement evidence, limited Superflex QB scarcity, and reviewed news. Raw subscriber or UDK rows are never published.

providers.name: Fantasy Footballers FootClan — private inputs
providers.scoring_format: Subscriber profile aligned to WFC full PPR / 4-point pass TD / Superflex context
providers.access: Private subscriber decision input; not re-published
providers.normalization: Private source rows are converted locally to WFC forward signals. They are never treated as a public trade-value provider or exposed as raw values.
providers.notes: Current coverage: partial_current_capture; 29 rostered-player inputs matched. Article signals are WFC-authored summaries, not copied articles.

providers.name: nflverse weekly usage inputs
providers.scoring_format: NFL weekly player statistics; WFC transforms these into usage/efficiency signals
providers.raw_scale: Weekly targets, shares, carries, EPA, and PPR points
providers.normalization: Not a trade-value source. In v2, usage and efficiency are ranked only within position and make modest PPG adjustments.
providers.notes: Attributed to nflverse / FTN Data (CC-BY-SA 4.0). 170 WFC-rostered players matched in the current cache.

providers.name: DraftSharks
providers.access: Manual transcription of the public Tier 1 and Tier 2 entries supplied by the commissioner for calibration research; no login, paywall, endpoint, or automated collection was used.
providers.normalization: Rank/value → percentile only after a permitted, reviewed snapshot is supplied
providers.notes: No automated fetch, paywall bypass, authentication, robots workaround, or anti-bot circumvention.

providers.notes: Source-specific terms and refresh policy must be reviewed before use.

providers.notes: WFC league results are canon context; any separate ESPN ranks require a reviewed, permitted snapshot.

limitations: Only WFC rostered skill players are in the initial pool.
A current private subscriber forward input is used only where captured; uncovered players fall back to the approved rank snapshot or production.
No schedule adjustment is assumed unless a reviewed team signal is supplied.
No news adjustment is assumed unless a reviewed, dated player signal is supplied.
External publisher values are comparison/calibration references only and are not reverse engineered or copied into this score.
The private preseason anchor is displayed only as an internal WFC-derived value; no UDK ranks, projections, ADP, or editorial text are published.

shadow_v2.model_summary: The v2 core uses a regressed scoring forecast, availability proxy, permitted private forward inputs where captured, and WFC-format value-over-replacement. Its output is blended into the live private-anchor market board.
limitations: Public nflverse player-stat signals are usage/efficiency inputs, not forward projections or external trade values.
A reviewed ROS projection or private permitted forward input only affects the forecast after it is captured locally; neither source row is published.
Injury and depth signals remain commissioner-reviewed until a permitted, reliable structured source is connected.
